adaptationNotes: Retained only as the supporting authority for the requested IANA timezone, recurrence serialization and validation, host-controlled values, and keyboard semantics inside the primary Wardian surface.

Adopt the timezone picker verbatim as an owned module: its cal-timezone-picker anatomy, cal-tzp classes, hoisted component-scoped style element, default IANA zone list, host zones and locale inputs, GMT offset option labels, and Time zone accessible name.
Map the picker's cal-* style variables onto the equivalent Astrale semantic tokens one for one and keep every declared fallback.

Adopt from the recurrence editor the two-way value resync against the host prop, the parse fallback that keeps the last valid recurrence instead of discarding it, the cal-rec__preview polite region with its no recurrence text, the Days of week group, the aria-pressed weekday buttons, and the Ends radiogroup.
Do not vendor the RRULE adapter: the primary Wardian surface owns the schedule value, so the adopted behavior operates on that value rather than on a serialized rule string.
